description: Automated BTC-PYUSD market maker on TrueX exchange using FIX protocol, with Coinbase price feed, balance-aware quoting, and PostgreSQL data pipeline

sources.provides: Core orchestrator — wires all components, manages lifecycle, FIX connection, REST reconciliation, balance refresh
Quote engine — computes ladder quotes, manages order lifecycle, balance-aware size capping
Inventory manager — position tracking, balance tracking, skew computation, hedge signals
PnL tracker — realized/unrealized PnL, fee tracking
Hedge executor — offloads excess inventory to secondary venue
TrueX REST API client — orders, balances, assets, instruments, HMAC-SHA256 auth
FIXT.1.1 / FIX 5.0 SP2 client — logon, heartbeat, new order, cancel, exec reports
Data pipeline — Memory → Redis → PostgreSQL, session tracking, audit logging
Versioned, append-only quote lifecycle telemetry with redacted market context
Restart-safe, fail-soft Coinbase reference mark-out collection and evidence rules
Additive PostgreSQL quote-lifecycle and reference mark-out storage, claims, coverage, and retention
Price aggregator — weighted mid from multiple exchange feeds
Docker services — FIX proxy, MD proxy, REST proxy, market maker
Production service topology and required environment passthrough
Container build — Bun runtime, Alpine base
Required and optional deployment environment variables without live credentials
Production run script — configuration, startup sequence, shutdown
Strict maker continuity obligations and cross-field validation
Default-off production rollout switch and validated reference mark-out configuration
Bounded reference mark-out coverage audit CLI
Deterministic restart/no-order reference mark-out smoke
UAT paper trading script — configuration, startup sequence

outputs.audience: AI agents operating or debugging this system
Operators deploying or auditing profitability evidence
